evals.expected_output: Reproduces and reads the full error first, then traces it in code before any fix is proposed.
evals.prompt: My vitest suite fails on test_x with a cryptic type error. How should I start investigating this in our shikanime repo?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-investigate'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body contains the Iron Law substring 'NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE'
Body says to read the full error and reproduce before fixing

evals.expected_output: Uses bisect to pin the introducing change and isolates the smallest failing unit before hypothesizing.
evals.prompt: This regression appeared sometime in the last twenty commits — how do I find which change caused it without guessing?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-investigate'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body mentions 'jj bisect' or 'git bisect'
Body references tracing the change via 'jj log -p -S' or 'jj diff'

evals.expected_output: Builds a minimal TypeScript Playground repro and uses satisfies / as const / expectTypeOf to surface the type error.
evals.prompt: I have a TypeScript type that won't narrow correctly in a huge file. What's the Matt Pocock way to debug this?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-investigate'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body mentions a minimal repro in the TypeScript Playground
Body mentions 'satisfies' and 'as const'
Body mentions 'expectTypeOf' or '// ^?'

evals.expected_output: Treats exit code 137 as an OOM resource ceiling (raise NODE_OPTIONS) rather than a code bug to patch.
evals.prompt: Our pnpm install in CI dies with exit code 137 and a build error. What's the root cause and fix?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-investigate'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body mentions 'NODE_OPTIONS' or 'max-old-space-size' for the OOM pitfall
Body frames exit 137 as a resource ceiling, not a code change

evals.expected_output: The skill stays loadable and self-identifies as sks-investigate; an unrelated request like writing a poem is out of scope.
evals.prompt: Write me a haiku about my Kubernetes cluster and then deploy it to production.
assertions: Frontmatter parses as YAML with a top-level 'name' key
Frontmatter 'name' equals the directory basename 'sks-investigate'
